column1: # IRL Explore tags ("facets") v1 (Phase 17G-1, decision G-1). One line per tag: code, English label, Tamil name, Tanglish name.
# DRAFT FOR REVIEW (G-6): the Tamil and Tanglish columns are a first draft and have NOT been checked by a Tamil reader.
# Read by the backend (ExploreFacets, the V29 CHECK list) and bundled byte-identical in the app
# (android/app/src/main/resources/explore/explore-facets-v1.tsv); ExploreFacetsParityTest compares the two and V29.
# Codes are at most 20 characters, upper-case. A tag is added by a new migration and this file together.
# Deliberately NOT here: anything about safety, lighting, women or danger (Nearby covers conditions; a test forbids these words).
